newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador bank liquidity down 1.02 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador bank liquidity down 1.02 pct in week.

text.p: Ecuador's Central Bank said Monday that liquidity in the banking system fell by 1.02 percent, or 207 million sucres, to 19.97 billion sucres in the week to July 18.
At the end of June, bank liquidity stood at 19.80 billion sucres.
Total liquidity in the bank sector ended 1996 at 16.99 billion sucres, up 35.8 percent from 1995.
